name: AniyaMusic
description: High-Performance Telegram Voice Chat Music & Video Streaming Engine powered by Pyrogram v2, PyTgCalls, MongoDB, and multi-platform resolvers.

API_ID.description: Telegram API ID obtained from https://my.telegram.org

API_HASH.description: Telegram API Hash obtained from https://my.telegram.org

MONGO_DB_URI.description: MongoDB Atlas connection string URI (e.g. mongodb+srv://...)

OWNER_ID.description: Telegram User ID of the primary bot administrator/owner

STRING_SESSION.description: Pyrogram v2 String Session for assistant client account

LOGGER_ID.description: Telegram Supergroup Log ID (bot must be admin with full permissions)

HEROKU_API_KEY.description: Heroku account API Key for automatic restarts/maintenance
